findings.title: CVE-2026-121637 - WatchGuard AuthPoint Gateway Improper HMAC Validation in LDAP Authentication Callback Allows Forged Authentication Results
findings.summary_md: Vendor advisory published 2026-11-04 (14:44 UTC) for an improper integrity validation flaw (CWE-345) in the LDAP authentication callback of WatchGuard AuthPoint Gateway, allowing a network attacker who has obtained a valid header signature to forge the authentication result and transaction identifier. CVSS v4.0 score 8.9 (high); affects AuthPoint Authentication Gateway 1.0 up to but not including 7.6.0, fixed in 7.6.0. Requires an LDAP provider configuration. WatchGuard states it is not aware of any exploitation in the wild and credits WatchGuard AI Security Research.

findings.title: CVE-2026-121638 - WatchGuard AuthPoint Gateway Improper Certificate Validation Allows Man-in-the-Middle Attacks
findings.summary_md: Vendor advisory published 2026-11-04 (14:44 UTC) for improper certificate validation (CWE-295) in WatchGuard AuthPoint Gateway, allowing an on-path attacker to intercept and modify communications between the Gateway and the LDAP server. CVSS v4.0 score 9.1 (critical); affects versions 1.0 up to but not including 7.6.0, fixed in 7.6.0. WatchGuard states it is not aware of any exploitation in the wild.

findings.title: CVE-2026-121639 - WatchGuard AuthPoint Gateway Improper Authentication Allows Unauthenticated Denial of Service
findings.summary_md: Vendor advisory published 2026-11-04 (14:44 UTC) for missing authentication for a critical function (CWE-306, CWE-287, CWE-252) in WatchGuard AuthPoint Gateway, allowing a remote unauthenticated attacker with network access to disrupt authentication services and delete the local directory synchronization configuration. CVSS v4.0 score 9.2 (critical); affects versions 1.0 up to but not including 7.6.0, fixed in 7.6.0. WatchGuard states it is not aware of any exploitation in the wild.

findings.title: CVE-2026-121640 - WatchGuard AuthPoint Gateway Capture-replay Allows Unauthorized Administrative Actions
findings.summary_md: Vendor advisory published 2026-11-04 (14:44 UTC) for an authentication bypass by capture-replay (CWE-294) in WatchGuard AuthPoint Gateway, allowing an attacker who has observed a legitimate request between Gateway components to replay it and perform unauthorized administrative actions including disrupting authentication services. CVSS v4.0 score 9.1 (critical); affects versions 1.0 up to but not including 7.6.0, fixed in 7.6.0. WatchGuard states it is not aware of any exploitation in the wild.
